cards.title: Would more hands-on dads create a more peaceful world?
cards.body: Scientist Sarah Blaffer Hrdy has rewritten the story of evolution by unpicking Darwinian sexism. Now she's turned her attention to exploring how involved fatherhood might shape society.

cards.title: Parents: please don't buy Grand Theft Auto VI for your child
cards.body: Rockstar Games' 18-rated game is stuffed with explicit sex, drugs, and violence—the most graphic content reviewers have encountered. It's genuinely unsuitable for children despite its popularity.

cards.title: My son's back home – and my mothering skills gone
cards.body: A graduate forced to return home amid economic pressures shifts family dynamics from holiday visits to permanent cohabitation. The realities of adult children living with parents reshape parental routines.

cards.title: Sales of baby sleeping bag halted after safety alarm
cards.body: Next has stopped selling a baby sleeping bag after a mother discovered the neck hole was dangerously oversized. The design posed a suffocation risk, with babies able to wriggle down and have their faces covered.

cards.title: Egg Donation: Is It Private, or a Secret?
cards.body: Parents using egg donation face complex questions about who needs to know and when to tell children. Understanding the difference between privacy and secrecy matters for healthy family relationships.

cards.title: 4 Ways to Support Eating Disorder Recovery This Holiday
cards.body: The holidays present unique challenges for those recovering from eating disorders. Family and friends can help by understanding triggers and offering practical, compassionate support.

cards.title: Why "Boundaries" Makes Boomer Parents Mad
cards.body: Adult children setting boundaries can feel to some parents like rejection or family abandonment. Research on generational differences in development helps explain this communication gap.

cards.title: The Music of Thanksgiving: Thirty Voices at One Table
cards.body: A multi-generational family singing together transforms a busy holiday into shared connection and rhythm. Kids to grandparents create collective gratitude through music.
